instruction: Use a lookup to read a file content
Use env lookup to read an environment variable

Use template lookup to render a string
output: ansible localhost -m debug -a 'msg={{ lookup("template", "Hello {{ name }}", name="World") }}'

instruction: Use the password lookup to generate a random password
output: ansible localhost -m debug -a 'msg={{ lookup("password", "/tmp/pwd chars=ascii_letters,digits length=16") }}'

instruction: Use the ini lookup to read values from a config file
output: ansible localhost -m debug -a 'msg={{ lookup("ini", "mysqld.max_connections type=properties file=/etc/mysql/my.cnf") }}'
